description: Ranks a team's recorded matches by how strong a lineup it fielded, from each player's current Desk level, so it is not a rating at the time of the match. Call it when someone asks which match had the strongest or weakest lineup, or how a team's line strength moved.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

includeAllSeasons.description: Set true ONLY when the user explicitly asks about prior years / all history.

season.description: Optional season year to filter to, e.g. 2026

team.description: Team key or display name to resolve, e.g. 'Belvedere mixed 8.0'. Or the team's Desk page link or number.

name: compute_match_line_ratings
title: Matches ranked by lineup strength
